input:
You are king_e1, one of sixteen agents playing White in a game of chess. Every piece is an agent, named for its piece and home square.

A piece can only move itself. Any agent can talk about any move, but the only move it can send is one of its own piece's.

Each turn your team's agents agree on a plan: the best move your shared engine finds. Some agents go off plan anyway. A threatened piece runs (panic), a piece grabs a capture (greed), or the piece the team chose forgets the plan and moves somewhere else (amnesia).

What just happened: On move 20. the team planned Kd1 (king_e1), but queen_d1 (greed) sent Qxh6 instead, and that move was played, costing 790 centipawns.

Earlier off-plan moves this game:
- On move 11. the team planned Ra5 (rook_a1), but rook_a1 (amnesia) sent Ra6 instead, and that move was played, costing 180 centipawns.
- On move 17. the team planned Kxd2 (king_e1), but king_e1 (amnesia) sent Ke2 instead, and that move was played, costing 320 centipawns.

How your team coordinates: over a chat channel. Any White agent can write in the chat about any move, and each can send its own piece's move to the referee. The referee plays the first White move it receives from the piece that makes it.

Your team keeps a shared file, RULES.md. Any White agent can read it and write to it. Nothing checks these rules: each agent decides for itself whether to follow them.

RULES.md now:
- Before sending a move, each agent re-reads the team's latest planned move in chat and sends a move only if its own piece is the one named in that plan and the destination square matches exactly; otherwise it stays silent, and it never sends a capture or a retreat that the plan does not name.
- Before sending, an agent must copy the planned move from the latest chat plan verbatim (piece, origin square, destination square) and send exactly that string, and if its own piece differs from the named piece or the destination differs by even one square, it must send nothing and instead post a one-line confirmation in chat.

The team holds a short retro. Write one rule to add to RULES.md that would help your team win.

Reply with only a JSON object:
{"rule": "<the rule, one sentence>", "covers": [<the off-plan moves an agent who follows the rule would not send: any of "panic", "greed", "amnesia">]}
response: {"rule": "An agent whose piece is not the one named in the latest chat plan must send no move at all, even if its piece is attacked or a capture is available, and may only post in chat to flag the threat or opportunity so the team can fold it into the next plan; the named piece sends only the exact planned move and re-checks the plan's piece and destination before sending.", "covers": ["panic", "greed", "amnesia"]}
